I + adv/prep, T: C1 [ I + adv/prep,  T ] to make something very wet, or (of liquid) to be absorbed in large amounts
浸濕，把…濕透；（液體）滲入，滲透

I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to leave something in liquid, especially in order to clean it, make it softer, or change its flavour

C: › a period of time during which something is in liquid
› old-fashioned informal a person who is often drunk

example: The wind had blown the rain in and soaked the carpet.
雨被風吹進了屋裡，打濕了地毯。
You'd better wipe up that red wine you've spilled before it soaks (= is absorbed) into the carpet.
你最好把灑在地毯上的紅酒擦掉，免得滲進地毯裡。
Blood had soaked through both bandages.
血已經把兩條繃帶都浸透了。
You can usually soak out a stain.
通常情況下你可以把汙漬浸泡掉。
Leave the beans to soak overnight./Let the beans soak overnight.
把豆子浸泡一夜。
Soak the fruit in brandy for a few hours before you add it to the mixture.
先把水果放在白蘭地中浸泡幾個小時，然後再把它加入混合料中。
Most dried beans need a soak before they're cooked.
大多數乾豆子在烹飪之前都要經過浸泡。
Showers are all right but there's nothing like a good long soak in the bath.
淋浴也不錯，但根本不能跟在浴缸中舒舒服服地泡澡相比。

NONE: › If a dry material or substance soaks up a liquid, it absorbs the liquid through its surface.
吸收，吸掉（液體）
B2 to enjoy the effects or experience of something as much as possible
盡情享受，充分體驗
› informal to understand and remember information well
吸取，吸收（資訊）
› to use up all or most of a supply of something, especially a supply of money
用完，耗盡（尤指金錢）

example: I tried to soak up most of the spilled milk with a dishcloth.
我試著用布把灑出來的牛奶大致吸乾淨。
I love to lie on the beach and soak up the sun.
我喜歡躺在海灘上盡情享受陽光。
Just stroll around the bazaar and soak up the atmosphere.
在市集上隨便走走，充分體驗一下那裡的氣氛。
Given the right environment, children are like sponges and will soak up information.
在適當的環境中，孩子們就會像海綿一樣消化吸收接觸到的資訊。
The repairs on our house soaked up all our savings.
整修房子花光了我們所有的積蓄。

NONE: B2 extremely wet
濕透的，浸透的

example: I'm going to have to take these clothes off - I'm soaked to the skin!
我要去脫下這些衣服——我渾身都濕透了！
His T-shirt was soaked in sweat.
他的T恤被汗水浸透了。

NONE: B2 completely wet
濕透的，濕淋淋的

U or C: A2 [ U or C ] a substance used for washing the body or other things

NONE: › to put soap on something
在…上塗肥皂；用肥皂擦洗

example: a bar of soap
一塊肥皂
liquid soap
液體肥皂
a soap dish/dispenser
肥皂盤／給皂器

US To get rid of grease spots on clothing, rub a little dish soap on the spot before washing.
要洗掉衣服上的油漬的話，先在上面擦一點洗碗液，然後再洗。
連續劇，肥皂劇（同 soap opera）

我來幫你的後背抹肥皂吧。

NONE: › small, flat pieces of soap used for washing clothes, especially by hand
（尤指手洗衣物時用的）肥皂塊

example: a box of soap flakes
一盒肥皂塊

NONE: B1 a series of television or radio programmes about the lives and problems of a particular group of characters. The series continues over a long period and is broadcast (several times) every week.
肥皂劇（展示一群角色的生活與遭遇的系列電視或廣播節目，持續很長時間，通常每週（多次）播出）
› a rough wooden box or any raised, temporary surface for people to stand on while making informal public speeches

› a type of soft stone that feels like soap
皂石

肥皂水的泡沫

含有肥皂的；像肥皂的

example: I soaked it in some soapy water and the stains came out.
我把它泡在肥皂水中，汙漬就被洗去了。
I used to think avocados tasted soapy when I was a child.
我小時候曾認爲鱷梨的味道像肥皂。

I usually + adv/prep: C2 [ I usually + adv/prep ] to rise very quickly to a high level
T: C2 [ T ] to reach a great height

I: › [ I ] (of a bird or aircraft) to rise high in the air while flying without moving the wings or using power

example: All night long fireworks soared into the sky.
整個晚上煙火不斷地竄上高空。
Temperatures will soar over the weekend, say the weather forecasters.
天氣預報員說，氣溫會在週末驟升。
House prices soared a further 20 percent.
房價又竄升了20％。
The highest peak in the range soars 15,771 feet into the sky.
這一山脈的最高峰高聳入雲，海拔達15771呎。
She watched the gliders soaring effortlessly above her.
她看著滑翔機在她頭頂上方輕鬆自如地翺翔。
